text: Ko onon yo ɓe gomɗimɓe Alla, ɓe golli ko O sar'inani ɓe kon, si on humanii rewɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen dewgal, refti on seerii ɓe ado on yottaade e maɓɓe, haray alanaa on e maɓɓe, edda woo, foti ko limirteeɗo laaɓal maa limirteeɗo lebbi, tawde rengaaji maɓɓe ɗin no laaɓiri waaseede yottagol e maɓɓe. Haray dakmitirii ɓe jawle mon ɗen, yeru mon on, fii jeejugol ɓe jaɓugol cergal ngal, jonnitiron ɓe mawɓe maɓɓe ɓen, ko aldaa e lorrugol ɓe.
